candidates: Auto-generated files (e.g., those emitted by `unplugin-vue-components`, build pipelines, or code-generation scripts such as the contributors JSON) must be added to `.gitignore` and, where appropriate, also to `.prettierignore` and `cSpell.json` `ignorePaths`, so they are excluded from version control, formatting, and spell-checking.
Do not leave commented-out or WIP code in a merge request — delete it before merging. Git history preserves prior versions, so deleted code can always be recovered if needed.

When adding or modifying scripts (e.g., under the root `scripts/` directory or `packages/mermaid/src/docs/.vitepress/scripts/`), use `ts-node-esm` — the project's established TypeScript script runner as seen in the root `package.json` — rather than introducing alternatives like `esno` or `tsx`, to keep script execution consistent across the project.

Prefer Node.js built-in `node:fs/promises` APIs over third-party filesystem utilities (such as `fs-extra`) when they offer equivalent functionality; for example, use `mkdir(path, { recursive: true })` instead of `fs-extra`'s `ensureDir` to avoid unnecessary dependencies.
